en-US.author: Julian Alarcon
en-US.description: Unofficial desktop client for Microsoft Outlook
en-US.name: Prospect Mail
en-US.releaseNotes:
What's Changed

🔒 Security
- bump electron to 44.10.0 (Node 24.22.1, fixes Broccoli2Shell CVE-2026-111497) (e95408c)

🐛 Bug Fixes
- handle clipboard.writeText promise rejection (Electron 44 API change) (c499ca8)

🔧 Build & CI
- link owner/repo#N references to their own repo in release notes (e6df3fc)
- run release notes workflow on Node 24 (bd99d1b)
- bump electron from 42.10.1 to 42.11.16 (dbdfc9a)
- bump electron-builder from 26.15.7 to 26.18.0 (3bc494b)
- bump js-yaml from 4.3.1 to 4.3.2 (2799c9d)
- bump brace-expansion from 1.1.18 to 1.1.21 (68f39ec)
- bump undici from 6.28.0 to 6.29.1 (487c423)
- bump fast-uri from 3.1.6 to 3.1.9 (4440f64)
- pin snapcraft to 8.x/stable to work around canonical/snapcraft#6519 (2780cb0)
